tasks.title: Set up PostgreSQL database schema with all tables (users, notes, study_groups, group_members, ratings, notifications) including indexes and relationships
Implement user authentication system with JWT, registration, login, email verification, and password hashing using Node.js/Express
Configure AWS S3 bucket for file storage and implement secure file upload/download endpoints with proper access controls
Build React components for Home Dashboard, Search & Browse Notes, and Note Details screens following the design specifications
Develop note sharing API endpoints (upload, browse, search, download) with course tagging, filtering, and rating calculation logic
Implement study group features including create group, join group, member management, and group listing APIs
Create React components for Study Groups, User Profile, and Notifications screens with responsive mobile-first design
Build rating and review system with API endpoints for submitting ratings, calculating averages, and displaying reviews
Implement notification system with real-time WebSocket support for group activities and new note alerts
Design and implement reusable UI components (buttons, cards, inputs, chips, modals) matching the design system specifications
Integrate frontend with backend APIs, implement state management, and ensure proper error handling and loading states
Perform end-to-end testing of core user flows (registration, note upload/download, group creation/joining) and fix critical bugs

risks: AWS S3 configuration and file upload security may require additional time for proper implementation and testing
Real-time notification system with WebSockets adds complexity and may impact initial MVP timeline
University email verification integration depends on external email service reliability and configuration
Database performance with rating calculations and search queries may need optimization as data grows
Mobile responsiveness across different devices and browsers requires extensive testing that may extend timeline
